title: 12th South Dream Retreat - Family Friendly!
description:
This 2100 square foot 3 bed/3 bath 1940's bungalow is the perfect respite in the best neighborhood in Nashville.  12 Avenue South is a walkers paradise lined with world class food, drink, and shopping.  The house features queen beds in all bedrooms, a foldout couch in the living room(can be closed off by doors), a futon upstairs, and queen air mattress! Relax on the front porch swing or have an al fresco meal on the back deck! Our private driveway easily fits 3 sedans. Free street parking also!

The space
The house is on a friendly, quiet street in a neighborhood of young families.  The back deck and fireplace are awesome additions.  I also love having an afternoon cocktail on the porch swing!   Kids welcome! We also stock Barista Parlor coffee beans for our guests to brew their coffee with!

1st Floor: 

Master bedroom w/ queen bed, en suite full bath with tub/shower combo

Hallway full bathroom with tub/shower combo

Living room 1

Living room 2 with IKEA sleeper sofa and doors that close the room off

Dining room 

Kitchen

Breakfast nook

Laundry area 

2nd floor:

Bedroom 2 with queen bed

Bedroom 3 with queen bed

Hallway full bathroom with walk in shower 

Office area with futon couch 

**4th bed in the house is the beige foldout sofa that's in the living room and can be enclosed by doors. We also have an air mattress to accommodate 2 more guests!

**Please note:  by agreeing to reserve you are stating that you will not hold us liable for injuries incurred in the house.**

Other things to note
*We highly recommend purchasing travel insurance as there are no exceptions made to our cancellation policy.
